rows.title: Meetings-led greenfield opens in Puebla Angelópolis
rows.body:
Oct 2024

Choice Hotels CALA inaugurated an 80-room Radisson in Puebla’s Angelópolis corridor—meetings, spa, and rooftop F&B for a secondary-city upscale box.

https://media.choicehotels.com/Choice-Hotels-CALA-inaugura-su-nuevo-hotel-Radisson-Puebla-Angelopolis

rows.title: Airport full-service opening at San Luis Potosí
rows.body:
Feb 2025

Radisson San Luis Potosí, Aeropuerto opened near Ponciano Arriaga—65 rooms positioned for airport capture and industrial-corridor transient demand.

https://media.choicehotels.com/Deleitate-con-nuestro-moderno-hotel-Radisson-en-San-Luis-Potosi

rows.title: Pacific coast beach conversion debuts at Playa Caracol
rows.body:
2025

Choice highlighted the Radisson Riviera Panama at Playa Caracol—core Radisson beach resort conversion on Panama’s Pacific coast, not Blu or RED.

https://media.choicehotels.com/2025-06-03-Choice-Hotels-Internationals-Global-Portfolio-Reaches-New-Heights-Driven-by-Upscale-and-Upper-Upscale-Growth-Internationally

rows.title: Historic downtown conversion opens in Paramaribo
rows.body:
Oct 2025

Radisson Hotel Paramaribo reopened on the former Krasnapolsky site—Choice’s first Suriname flag and a landmark downtown full-service conversion.

https://www.choicehotels.com/en-de/suriname/paramaribo/radisson-hotels/sr001
